{{Top}}
'''Hyperwaves''' were signals sent through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. They were primarily used for faster-than-light communications, such as in [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transceivers]] or [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transmitters]]; however, such techniques had relatively short ranges, far shorter than the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].

[[Hyperwave signal interceptor]]s used hyperwaves to detect activation or deactivation of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]. [[Hyperwave inertial momentum sustainer]]s used hyperwaves to stop [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction fields]].
